title: 正文 第二章 生命源泉
content_zh:
规则之眼布下的封印犹如天威，捆缚了一切。整个世界都变得灰黑一片，被枯寂和腐败占据，充满了死亡与杀戮。唯有昏黄的漩风，无休止的游荡在满目苍痍的大地上。

    只不过这一次的旋风有些不同，昏黄的旋风中出现了一道道猩红的目光。

    “这些旋风有些诡异，望之不穿，我只能大概感应到有十三头异兽。”乐萱皱着眉头，有些吃力。

    “乐萱妹子你已经很厉害了，这里的风可不简单，乃是风生兽王的酣睡气息所化。具有隔绝灵识之力的作用，你的通灵仙体还太弱小自然感应不到。”徐辉讨好的说道，自从知道她是林雅的师妹，徐辉这一路上可没少献殷勤。

    “不对，他们不是风生兽。”幻天眼眸流转紫色光芒，很是警惕。

    “根据家族历来先辈的记载，这里是风生兽蛰伏之地没错啊！难道你——能——看——穿——这——旋——风。”徐辉正回忆家族留下来的信息，却看见幻天眼眸流转紫色光芒，目不转睛的盯着旋风深处，使得他下半句话打顿。其他人亦是如此，大张嘴巴，连可爱的乐萱也是如此，惊讶的说道：“你好厉害，比感识，你是第一个超越我的同境界之人。”

    “防御战阵。”幻天忽略几人的惊讶表情，摆出几人事先说明的战斗方式，将乐萱护在了中央。

    “你是如何看透风生兽王的酣睡气息的？据我了解，你们东皇家可没有这个能力，至少你这个境界还做不到。”小和尚怀疑，拿出了一个闪烁暗金光芒的金钵，护在了胸前。

    “如果没有特殊本领，那几个老家伙如何能让我这个力轮第一重的子孙来到此地。”幻天随意忽悠。

    “老家伙！幻兄果然也是性情中人。”徐辉重复幻天的话语，很是投机。

    “不知幻兄是如何看出它们不是风声兽的。”苍岚提问。

    “风生兽我也见过几只，可是我没见过长着鳞片的风生兽。”

    “管他呢！先抓它几只再说。”徐辉跃跃欲试。

    “徐兄霸气，风生兽速度奇快，皮毛坚韧。只要不将其震碎，得风之，须臾之间便会复活，你确定要在这里抓取它们。”苍岚打击。

    “开个玩笑，苍兄那么认真干嘛！”

    “破晓天尽。”幻天不理会几人的吵闹，施展他记忆中为数不多的幻氏秘法。双眸闪耀紫光，浩荡而去。如同穿云利箭，刺破昏黄的旋风，向着周围看去，寻找出路。

    于此同时，以此地为中心，无数的外来之人和此地异种，都被这破入云霄的紫光所惊扰。幻天如同一个药引子，引起了一场人心风暴，触动了太多居心叵测的人们。

    “什么？好强的秘法，竟然能在遗落之地引发如此异象，真不知道和幻兄你在一起是福还是祸。”几人目瞪口呆，再一次被幻天的行为所惊讶。

    “走，去那边。”幻天首当其冲，带动几人离开。

    “幻兄，不会搞错了吧！这边风生兽最多。”

    “多就对了，如果我没有猜错，那边因该是另一只兽王的领域。而兽王领地意识极强，不想爆发兽王之战的话，这些风生兽不会追过去的。”

    “吼吼吼……”吼声如雷，充满了暴虐。

    似是发现了几人行走的方向，十几头风生兽彻底狂暴，向着几人扑击而去。其中最为强大的一头风生兽冲向了幻天，对于它们来说，幻天是特殊的，必须抢先杀死。

    看着扑击过来的风生兽，幻天震动指掌， 一掌切出，斩向风生兽前爪的关节处。两者砰然作响，强大的力量超出了幻天的想象，幻天被撞的连连后退。一双素手伸出，轻轻的抵住了他的后背。“幻大哥，你身受重伤，还是换我来吧！”

    幻天点头，此时不是逞强的时候。

    “变换阵型。”苍岚大喊一身。几人随之变换阵型，组成了一个常用的利箭阵。苍岚为首，徐辉和能忍小和尚分守两边，乐萱殿后。三角阵如同一柄利剑豁开风生兽的围攻，冲向幻天所指引的目的地。

    苍岚直接舍去了手中重剑，整个人如同一头人形凶兽，每一击都是势大力沉，与之碰撞的风生兽无不翻滚飞出。左边的徐辉手持一柄利剑，被他舞动的密不透风，冲过来的风生兽，稍有迟疑便被他分解成为了一堆肉片。而右边的能忍小和尚惦着一个巨大的金钵，每颂一次佛号重击一次，手下丝毫不见仁慈之色。

The seal placed by the Eye of Rules is like the power of God, binding everything. The entire world has become gray and black, occupied by desolation and corruption, and full of death and killing. Only the dim yellow whirlwind wandered endlessly on the desolate land.

    But this time the whirlwind was a little different. Scarlet eyes appeared in the dim whirlwind.

    "These whirlwinds are a bit weird, and I can't see through them. I can only roughly sense that there are thirteen strange beasts." Le Xuan frowned, struggling a little.

    "Sister Le Xuan, you are already very powerful. The wind here is not simple. It is formed by the sleeping breath of the wind-born beast king. It has the effect of isolating the power of spiritual consciousness. Your psychic immortal body is still too weak to sense it." Xu Hui said flatteringly. Ever since he knew that she was Lin Ya's junior sister, Xu Hui had been very attentive along the way.

    "No, they are not wind-born beasts." Huantian's eyes were filled with purple light, and he was very alert.

    “根据家族历来先辈的记载，这里是风生兽蛰伏之地没错啊！难道你——能——看——穿——这——旋——风。”徐辉正回忆家族留下来的信息，却看见幻天眼眸流转紫色光芒，目不转睛的盯着旋风深处，使得他下半句话打顿。 The others also opened their mouths wide, even the lovely Le Xuan said in surprise: "You are so powerful. You are the first person to surpass my level."

    "Defensive battle formation." Huantian ignored the surprised expressions of several people, put on the fighting method explained by several people in advance, and protected Le Xuan in the center.

    "How did you see through the sleeping aura of the Feng Sheng Beast King? As far as I know, your Eastern Royal Family does not have this ability, at least not at your level." The young monk was suspicious and took out a golden bowl that shone with dark gold light and protected it in front of his chest.

    "If you don't have special skills, how can those old guys let me, a descendant of the first level of the force wheel, come here." Huantian fooled around casually.

    “老家伙！幻兄果然也是性情中人。”徐辉重复幻天的话语，很是投机。

    "I don't know how Brother Huan knew that they were not wind-sounding beasts." Cang Lan asked.

    "I have seen a few wind-born beasts, but I have never seen a wind-born beast with scales."

    "Whatever! Let's catch a few of them first." Xu Hui was eager to give it a try.

    "Brother Xu is domineering. The wind beast is extremely fast and has tough fur. As long as it is not shattered and the wind is obtained, it will be resurrected in a moment. You must capture them here." Cang Lan struck.

    "Just kidding, Brother Cang, why are you so serious!"

    "The sky ends at dawn." Huantian ignored the noise of several people and used the few secret techniques of the Huan family in his memory. His eyes sparkled with purple light, and he walked away mightily.如同穿云利箭，刺破昏黄的旋风，向着周围看去，寻找出路。

    At the same time, centered around this place, countless outsiders and alien species were disturbed by the purple light that broke into the sky. Huantian is like a medicine introduction, causing a storm in people's hearts and touching too many people with ulterior motives.

    “什么？好强的秘法，竟然能在遗落之地引发如此异象，真不知道和幻兄你在一起是福还是祸。”几人目瞪口呆，再一次被幻天的行为所惊讶。

    "Let's go over there." Huantian was the first to bear the brunt and led several people to leave.

    "Brother Huan, there's no mistake! There are the most wind beasts here."

    "That's right. If I'm not wrong, that side should be the domain of another Beast King. The Beast King has a strong sense of territory. If he doesn't want a Beast King war to break out, these wind-born beasts won't chase after him."

    "Ho ho ho..." The roar was like thunder, full of violence.

    As if they had discovered the direction in which the few people were walking, a dozen wind beasts went completely berserk and pounced towards the few people. One of the most powerful wind-born beasts rushed towards Huantian. For them, Huantian was special and must be killed first.

    Looking at the wind-born beast that was attacking, Huantian shook his palms and cut out with one palm, slashing towards the joint of the wind-born beast's front paw. The two banged, and the powerful force exceeded Huantian's imagination, and Huantian was knocked back continuously. A pair of plain hands stretched out and gently touched his back. "Brother Huan, you are seriously injured, it's better for me to do it!"

    Huantian nodded. This was not the time to show off.

    "Change the formation." Cang Lan shouted. Several people then changed their formations and formed a commonly used sharp arrow formation. Cang Lan was the leader, Xu Hui and the young monk Neng Ren were on both sides, and Le Xuan was at the rear.三角阵如同一柄利剑豁开风生兽的围攻，冲向幻天所指引的目的地。

    Cang Lan directly dropped the heavy sword in his hand, and his whole body was like a humanoid ferocious beast. Every blow was powerful and heavy, and all the wind-born beasts that collided with it rolled and flew out. Xu Hui on the left was holding a sharp sword, and he danced it so airtight that the wind beast that rushed towards him was broken into a pile of meat pieces by him after a slight hesitation. The Nengren young monk on the right is thinking about a huge golden bowl, hitting it hard every time he chants the Buddha's name, and there is no mercy at all.
